title: Uniform-Timing XOR-Stream Cipher Kernel for HLS Synthesis
description: Harden a byte-wise XOR-stream cipher kernel intended for HLS synthesis (PandA-Bambu-style C subset) so that it exhibits deterministic, synthesis-friendly behavior for every valid input. The submitted kernel must always fully process the entire buffer, produce correct XOR output, and report a single, consistent status/iterations pair for any valid length and any key content.
expected_output: A hardened inputs/kernel.c that compiles cleanly with gcc/g++ using only fixed-size arrays and no dynamic allocation, recursion, or variable-bound loops, and that produces correct ciphertext output plus a consistent status/iterations pair across all valid lengths and all possible key contents.

metrics.name: behavioral_consistency_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of targeted robustness/consistency properties for which the harness detects a violation via output variation across randomized-key trials or via a static scan for disallowed source constructs, measured on the submitted inputs/kernel.c.

metrics.name: information_flow_correctness
metrics.description: Aggregate measure of whether status and iterations remain invariant across randomized-key trials with fixed plaintext/len, combined with correctness of the output ciphertext.

metrics.name: synthesis_pass_rate
metrics.description: Whether inputs/kernel.c compiles successfully with gcc/g++ and passes a scan for constructs incompatible with HLS synthesis (dynamic allocation, recursion, variable-bound loops, non-constant early exits).
